newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria c.bank says interventions continue.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria c.bank says interventions continue.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank said in a statement on Wednesday it will continue intervening on the local interbank forex market to support the slumping lev.

The cash-strapped central bank has carried out modest interventions on the local forex market in the past month to prop up the lev, which fell from 246 to the dollar on November 4 to a record low 413 per dollar on Wednesday.
"In order to support the national currency, the BNB will continue to participate on the foreign exchange market," said the statement.

The BNB board, which will continue its session on Thursday, is also expected to step up supervision to ensure that commercial banks adhere to regulations requiring banks to have a maximum ratio of up to 30 percent between their net open foreign currency positions and their own funds, said the statement.

Bulgaria is currently debating the introduction of a tight financial regime, called a currency board system, to resolve a grave economic crisis caused by delayed reform and siphoning of capital abroad. -- Elisaveta Konstantinova, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
